live.description: Lines from the sources as they arrive, read from the raw log without waiting for the database.
live.privacy: This page shows personal data; every stream started (with its filter) and every raw line opened are written to the audit log.

privacyWait.title: Waiting for the KVKK privacy notice
privacyWait.body: The live tail shows personal data: read and accept the privacy notice before starting it.

filters.label: Live tail filter
filters.everything: No filter: every new line of every source comes in.

banner.failed: The live tail could not start
banner.reopened: Lines in between may not have been shown; open this interval in Search.

list.label: Live lines
list.waiting: Waiting for a new line that matches the filter.
list.empty: Press Start: new lines that match the filter appear here (newest at the bottom, at most 2,000 lines).

sheet.title: Live line
sheet.subtitle: {{source}} · {{day}} · line {{line}}
sheet.previewHint: The fields were parsed as the line arrived; the record loaded into the database may differ in details. The whole line is in the raw line.
sheet.skippedHint: The server could not parse this many lines; the line is shown without its fields.
sheet.invalidHint: The line is not in the collector's format (e.g. a torn line); it is not loaded into the database.

highlight.title: Highlight rules
highlight.description: Type a text (marked where it occurs) or field:value (e.g. action:deny; the whole line is marked). At most 10 rules.
highlight.kindField: Field rule: the whole line is marked.
highlight.kindText: Text rule: marked where it occurs.
highlight.storage: The rules are kept in this tab only: they stay when the page reloads and are gone when the tab closes.
highlight.unsaved: The browser could not keep the rules; they apply until the page reloads.
